what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in Austria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7224 Iranian refugees in Austria, 4.6% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1993 to 2025, most recently with Jaish al-Adl, and over Kurdistan territory in some years.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 1561 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 7664, at the end of 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
These are year-end totals for Austria only, reported to UNHCR.
